calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for AirHelp
calls.summary: AirHelp is currently utilizing GrowthBook for A/B testing across three main projects, appreciating its ease of use and effectiveness over previous tools. The team, including Pedro Duque and Ahmed Teailab, highlighted GrowthBook's metrics and test setup, currently running about 10 active experiments with plans to scale to 50 tests per quarter. They are interested in the Enterprise plan for features like holdout groups and advanced statistical tools. With approximately 30 million annual visitors and a significant conversion funnel, AirHelp's growth ambitions necessitate effective scaling of their A/B testing program. Pricing discussions revealed concerns over the high cost of the Enterprise plan at $50,000 annually, prompting a need for a value-driven pricing proposal. A follow-up meeting is scheduled to align on expected outcomes and budget.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, A/B Testing, Enterprise Plan, Holdout Groups, Pricing Model, Experimentation Scale
calls.action_items:
